## Summary

Describe what this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Rule behavior change

## Validation

List commands/tests run (for example: `pytest -q`, `ruff check .`, snapshots).

## Risk and compatibility

State any config/schema/output compatibility impact and migration notes.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added/updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Docs updated (if user-facing)
- [ ] Rule stability updated (experimental/stable/deprecated) if behavior changed
- [ ] No breaking config/schema changes without a major version bump
